scope: Literal authored core input/complete expected output, ten exact path-stage cases and twenty malformed-input cases. All names, IDs, hashes and roots are synthetic; this is not a constructor run or production admission envelope.

limits: All tables are conservative declarations. No actual fetch/compile/render result is predicted.
Static unlinked global slots stay inventoried; zero-face linked slots are not filtered.
Animated true is a node-key fact; hook/placement/cache/GL predicates remain unobserved.
Original loader names remain distinct even when trimmed HTTP paths or body jobs coincide.
Node numeric markers and diagnostics are preserved, not repaired or a format-validity verdict.
All carried core and ground gaps stay explicit; declarations cover returned tables, while exceptions retain unknown tables.

stage_contract: For each stage case, copy stage_input; replace model_rows[0].summary.textures with [raw_name] and texture_declarations with [expected]. Require the one unchanged declaration plus nested_target_index=0/node_links=[] and exactly one nested target/referrer. No encoding is computed in the expected values.
refusal_contract: Start each refusal from a fresh deep copy of input. JSON Pointer set replaces an existing value; delete removes a member/array element. Every case must throw a Refusal. Only R20 prescribes reason=uri_encoding_unsupported: compute exact raw-name encoding before comparing supplied HTTP stages. Do not preempt that case with a generic scalar-string validator.

refusal_cases.purpose: The empty-table target still requires its constructor job; no silent omission.
Duplicate physical job IDs cannot overwrite an earlier table.
A returned result is not an admitted clean worker observation after exit1.
returned outcome cannot be reinterpreted as constructor false.
Distinct target records retain unique dense model ordinals.
Every target must link to exactly one existing constructor observation.
A second filename cannot borrow a table from different body bytes.
No fallback from an absent source job index to array position0.
Do not duplicate one parent while losing the distinct untrimmed loader entry.
Model placement links cannot be taken from ground-texture metadata.
Declared loader index must agree with its position and referrers.
Even a repeated placement does not change the source entry's exact first-occurrence pointer.
Original loader stages must bind to the exact target, not a nearby name.
The raw slot true is valid preserved data but its claim to integer table0 is inconsistent.
The raw null slot remains unresolved; no Number(null) coercion.
A node with rotation count1 contradicts false node-key animation; this does not evaluate hooks or compile.
Root3 still has rsw.job_id null and cannot disappear from the carried gap list.
JSON bool-vs-number identity is strict outside preserved raw slot values.
A model-target referrer must retain its exact model role.
No correct HTTP stage exists for this raw scalar; the supplied HTTP string is an unreachable placeholder.
